prior.cause: Parser fault injection ran before factory initialization and affected the runtime-looked-up built inline track Worker. Move only parser fault injection after factory+flush; assertions unchanged; no production change needed for these failures.

Parser fault injection ran before factory initialization and affected the runtime-looked-up built inline track Worker. Move only parser fault injection after factory+flush; assertions unchanged; no production change needed for these failures.

decisions: Preserve internal instance return identity, synchronous array prefix and sequential await emit.
Cancel only superseded replacements and all loads on destroy; independent appends survive replacement. Cancelled public loads resolve the internal instance silently.
Preserve input object normalization and legacy XML fields; correct explicit time zero.
Commit validated configuration; compare callable/Promise identity and retain ordinary structural equality.
Observe automatic initial load rejection locally; public load emits original error once and rejects.
Rollback early destroy subscription on initial configuration or track Worker failure; correct the existing resize callback identity.
limitations: This step is JS responsibility separation; full owned TS and installed public declarations are task 06.
Track scheduling, pending visibility, settings lifecycle, heatmap and long-run native overlap remain open.
ESM built successfully but is not counted among the three controlled/native runtime variants.
Native tests use local XML/fault fixtures; no live Bilibili, CSP matrix, physical Safari or npm release acceptance.
